knowledge:
- key_parameters: classify_obj=The Seurat or SingleCellExperiment object containing the single-cell data to be classified ;; train_obj=The Seurat or SingleCellExperiment object used for training a new classifier ;; test_obj=The Seurat or SingleCellExperiment object used for testing classifier performance ;; assay=The assay name in the object to use (e.g., 'RNA' or 'counts') ;; layer=The layer name in the object to use (e.g., 'counts' or 'data') ;; cell_types=A vector of cell types to classify, or 'all' to use all available models ;; path_to_models=The directory path where models are stored, or 'default' to use package-integrated pretrained models ;; tag_slot=The metadata column name containing the ground-truth cell type annotations for training or testing ;; parent_classifier=An S4 scAnnotatR object representing the parent cell type classifier, required when training or testing a child/subtype model ;; parent_cell=The name of the parent cell type model in the database, used as an alternative to parent_classifier ;; ignore_ambiguous_result=Logical; if TRUE, hides ambiguous predictions where multiple cell types satisfy the probability thresholds, reporting only the more specific cell type
- alternatives: Traditional cell type assignment based on manual gating of canonical marker gene expression (e.g., using CD19 and MS4A1 to identify B cells)
- when_to_use: Use when you have single-cell RNA-seq data (Seurat or SingleCellExperiment) and want to quickly annotate immune cell types using pretrained models, or when you have labeled reference single-cell datasets and want to train custom SVM classifiers for specific cell types or subtypes
- pitfalls: Imbalanced training datasets (e.g., 90% positive cells) can bias the model; the package automatically down-samples the majority group to balance them, which might reduce the training set size ;; Cell types containing special characters like /, ,, -, [+], [.], _or_, -or-, [(], [)], or the word 'ambiguous' are treated as ambiguous and removed from training/testing ;; If a training dataset does not contain any cells of the target cell type, training will fail ;; For child models, some annotated child cells might be negative to the parent classifier and will be removed from training/testing ;; When saving a child model to a fresh local database, the parent model must be saved first

workflows.name: cell_classification_pretrained
workflows.intent: Classify cell types in a single-cell RNA-seq dataset using pretrained models.
input: tirosh_mel80_example (Seurat object containing single-cell RNA-seq data)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the scAnnotatR package ;; 2. Load the default pretrained models ;; 3. Load the single-cell dataset ;; 4. Run cell classification using classify_cells ;; 5. Inspect the classification results in the metadata ;; 6. Visualize the predicted cell types and prediction probabilities using Seurat plotting functions
workflows.code:
library(scAnnotatR)
default_models <- load_models("default")
names(default_models)
default_models[['B cells']]
data("tirosh_mel80_example")
tirosh_mel80_example
head(tirosh_mel80_example[[]])
seurat.obj <- classify_cells(classify_obj = tirosh_mel80_example, 
                             assay = 'RNA', layer = 'counts',
                             cell_types = c('B cells', 'NK', 'T cells'), 
                             path_to_models = 'default')
seurat.obj[[]][c(50:60), c(8:ncol(seurat.obj[[]]))]
Seurat::DimPlot(seurat.obj, group.by = "most_probable_cell_type")
Seurat::FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = "B_cells_p")
Seurat::FeaturePlot(seurat.obj, features = c("CD19", "MS4A1"), ncol = 2)

workflows.name: train_basic_classifier
workflows.intent: Train a new SVM classifier for an independent cell type and evaluate its performance.
input: zilionis (SingleCellExperiment object containing labeled single-cell RNA-seq data)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the dataset and split it into training and testing sets ;; 2. Define ground-truth cell labels, marking unknown or NA cells as 'ambiguous' ;; 3. Define a set of marker genes for the target cell type ;; 4. Train the classifier using train_classifier ;; 5. Evaluate the classifier on the test set using test_classifier ;; 6. Plot the ROC curve of the test results ;; 7. Save the trained model to a local directory and optionally delete it
workflows.code:
library(scRNAseq)
library(scAnnotatR)
zilionis <- ZilionisLungData()
zilionis <- zilionis[, 1:5000]
colnames(zilionis) <- paste0("Cell", 1:ncol(zilionis))
pivot = ncol(zilionis) %/% 2
train_set <- zilionis[, 1:pivot]
test_set <- zilionis[, (1+pivot):ncol(zilionis)]
unique(train_set$`Most likely LM22 cell type`)
unique(test_set$`Most likely LM22 cell type`)
train_set$B_cell <- unlist(lapply(train_set$`Most likely LM22 cell type`, function(x) if (is.na(x)) { 'ambiguous' } else if (x %in% c('Plasma cells', 'B cells memory', 'B cells naive')) { 'B cells' } else { 'others' }))
test_set$B_cell <- unlist(lapply(test_set$`Most likely LM22 cell type`, function(x) if (is.na(x)) { 'ambiguous' } else if (x %in% c('Plasma cells', 'B cells memory', 'B cells naive')) { 'B cells' } else { 'others' }))
table(train_set$B_cell)
selected_marker_genes_B <- c("CD19", "MS4A1", "CD79A", "CD79B", 'CD27', 'IGHG1', 'IGHG2', 'IGHM', "CR2", "MEF2C", 'VPREB3', 'CD86', 'LY86', "BLK", "DERL3")
set.seed(123)
classifier_B <- train_classifier(train_obj = train_set, cell_type = "B cells", marker_genes = selected_marker_genes_B, assay = 'counts', tag_slot = 'B_cell')
classifier_B
caret_model(classifier_B)
classifier_B_test <- test_classifier(classifier = classifier_B, test_obj = test_set, assay = 'counts', tag_slot = 'B_cell')
classifier_B_test$overall_roc
roc_curve <- plot_roc_curve(test_result = classifier_B_test)
plot(roc_curve)
save_new_model(new_model = classifier_B, path_to_models = tempdir(), include.default = FALSE)
delete_model("B cells", path_to_models = tempdir())

workflows.name: train_child_classifier
workflows.intent: Train a classifier for a cell subtype (child model) that depends on a parent classifier.
input: zilionis (SingleCellExperiment object containing labeled single-cell RNA-seq data)
workflows.stages: 1. Load the parent classifier from default models ;; 2. Prepare training and testing datasets, removing NA cells and defining subtype labels ;; 3. Define marker genes for the subtype ;; 4. Train the child classifier using train_classifier with the parent classifier specified ;; 5. Evaluate the child classifier on the test set using test_classifier ;; 6. Save both parent and child classifiers to a local database ;; 7. Classify cells using the newly trained local database via classify_cells
workflows.code:
library(scAnnotatR)
default_models <- load_models('default')
classifier_B <- default_models[['B cells']]
library(scRNAseq)
zilionis <- ZilionisLungData()
zilionis <- zilionis[, 1:5000]
colnames(zilionis) <- paste0("Cell", 1:ncol(zilionis))
pivot = ncol(zilionis)%/%2
train_set <- zilionis[, 1:pivot]
test_set <- zilionis[, (1+pivot):ncol(zilionis)]
train_set <- train_set[, !is.na(train_set$`Most likely LM22 cell type`)]
test_set <- test_set[, !is.na(test_set$`Most likely LM22 cell type`)]
train_set$plasma <- unlist(lapply(train_set$`Most likely LM22 cell type`, function(x) if (x == 'Plasma cells') {1} else {0}))
test_set$plasma <- unlist(lapply(test_set$`Most likely LM22 cell type`, function(x) if (x == 'Plasma cells') {1} else {0}))
table(train_set$plasma)
selected_marker_genes_plasma <- c('BACH2', 'BLK', 'CD14', 'CD19', 'CD27', 'CD37', 'CD38', 'CD40LG', 'CD74', 'CD79A', 'CD79B', 'CD83', 'CD84', 'CD86', 'CR2', 'DERL3', 'FLI1', 'IGHG1', 'IGHG2', 'IGHM', 'IL2RA', 'IRF8', 'LRMP', 'LY86', 'MCL1', 'MEF2C', 'MME', 'MS4A1', 'MVK', 'MZB1', 'POU2AF1', 'PTEN', 'RASGRP2', 'SDC1', 'SP140', 'TCF3', 'VPREB3')
set.seed(123)
classifier_plasma <- train_classifier(train_obj = train_set, marker_genes = selected_marker_genes_plasma, cell_type = "Plasma cells", assay = 'counts', tag_slot = 'plasma', parent_classifier = classifier_B)
set.seed(123)
classifier_plasma <- train_classifier(train_obj = train_set, marker_genes = selected_marker_genes_plasma, cell_type = "Plasma cells", assay = 'counts', tag_slot = 'plasma', parent_cell = 'B cells')
classifier_plasma
caret_model(classifier_plasma)
classifier_plasma_test <- test_classifier(test_obj = test_set, classifier = classifier_plasma, assay = 'counts', tag_slot = 'plasma', parent_classifier = classifier_B)
print(classifier_plasma_test$auc)
roc_curve <- plot_roc_curve(test_result = classifier_plasma_test)
plot(roc_curve)
save_new_model(new_model = classifier_B, path_to_models = tempdir(), include.default = FALSE)
save_new_model(new_model = classifier_plasma, path_to_models = tempdir(), include.default = FALSE)
classified <- classify_cells(classify_obj = test_set, assay = 'counts', cell_types = 'all', path_to_models = tempdir())
table(classified$predicted_cell_type, classified$plasma)
table(classified$most_probable_cell_type, classified$plasma)
classified <- classify_cells(classify_obj = test_set, assay = 'counts', cell_types = 'all', path_to_models = tempdir(), ignore_ambiguous_result = TRUE)
table(classified$predicted_cell_type, classified$plasma)
